As the next step, the updated draft will be shared with the wider relevant stakeholders for consultations.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration expedite its review and revision of the administrative instruction on programme support accounts to ensure effective utilization of the programme support cost funds.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented. The recommendation was for the Administration to review and revise the administrative instruction on programme support costs. The Administration provided evidence that new guidance on programme support costs had been issued and that the criteria for the closure of this recommendation had been met. Therefore, the Administration respectfully requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: As clarified by the Administration during the field audit, administrative instructions promulgate high-level key principles on the basis of relevant resolutions of the General Assembly, are issued by the Under-Secretary-General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, and constitute part of the formal regulatory framework of the Organization. Guidelines cover operational processes and procedures, enable the appropriate interpretation and implementation of administrative instructions and are usually issued by heads of entity as internal Secretariat documents. The new guidance issued is not the administrative instruction referred to in the recommendation. Therefore, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration expedite its review and revision of the administrative instruction on programme support accounts to ensure the effective utilization of the programme support cost funds.
history.administration_response: On 7 April 2025, the Administration issued new comprehensive guidelines on the management of programme support costs to ensure accountable and effective utilization in full compliance with the Financial Regulations and Rules of the United Nations. In addition, the Administration drafted a revised administrative instruction on programme support costs to replace the administrative instruction on programme support accounts (ST/AI/286). The new administrative instruction is based on the new guidelines and covers the higher-level governing principles of all the details that are included in the guidelines. The draft administrative instruction was submitted to the Office of Human Resources, and the formal consultation process with all heads of entity across the Secretariat was concluded. The formal review process with the Office of Legal Affairs, the Office of Human Resources, the Executive Office of the Secretary- General and the Office of the Under- Secretary-General of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance is expected to be finalized in 2026. Unlike the guidelines, which are very detailed, covering numerous financial management and operational aspects, the administrative instruction format is at a principle-based level. Considering that the guidelines on the management of programme support costs already provide a comprehensive and detailed framework for the management of such costs, addressing all the concerns and operational and financial risks highlighted by the Board, and given that the new administrative instruction derives from and is based on the guidelines, the Administration considers the recommendation as fully implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that administrative instructions are high-level regulatory documents promulgated by the Under- Secretary-General of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance under General Assembly resolutions, whereas guidelines are only internal operational supplements lower in the regulatory hierarchy, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
